description: This file defines the ModelRecord class, which models a data record with properties such as name, type code, description, parent/child relationships, and associated fields. It includes methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

classes.name: ModelRecord
classes.description: Represents a data record with metadata such as name, type code, description, parent/child relationships, and fields.

methods.name: getModelField
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelField object by its name from the list of fields.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the record.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the record.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the record.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the record.

methods.name: getParentName
methods.description: Returns the parent record's name.

methods.name: setParentName
methods.description: Sets the parent record's name.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields in the record.

methods.name: setFields
methods.description: Sets the list of fields in the record.

methods.name: getTypeCode
methods.description: Returns the type code of the record.

methods.name: getTcPosition
methods.description: Returns the position of the type code.

methods.name: setTypeCode
methods.description: Sets the type code of the record.

methods.name: setTcMin
methods.description: Sets the minimum type code.

methods.name: setTcMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum type code.

methods.name: setTcIsNum
methods.description: Sets whether the type code comparison is numeric.

methods.name: getTcMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum type code.

methods.name: getTcMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum type code.

methods.name: getTcLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the type code.

methods.name: setTcPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the type code.

methods.name: setTcMinNum
methods.description: Sets the minimum type code as a number.

methods.name: setTcMaxNum
methods.description: Sets the maximum type code as a number.

methods.name: getTcMinNum
methods.description: Returns the minimum type code as a number.

methods.name: getTcMaxNum
methods.description: Returns the maximum type code as a number.

methods.name: isTcIsNum
methods.description: Checks if type code comparison is numeric.

methods.name: setTcLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the type code.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the record limit under the parent.

methods.name: getParentRecord
methods.description: Returns the parent ModelRecord.

methods.name: getChildRecords
methods.description: Returns the list of child ModelRecords.

methods.name: setParentRecord
methods.description: Sets the parent ModelRecord.
